title: Sacred Geometry - An A-Z Reference Guide
author: Marilyn Walker
description: Sacred Geometry: An A-Z Reference Guide by Marilyn Walker, PhD, published by Rockridge Press with the subtitle History, Beliefs and Practices. Arranged as an alphabetical encyclopedia preceded by an introduction, it defines the key shapes, numbers, ratios and concepts of sacred geometry, including the circle, vesica piscis, Flower of Life, Metatron's Cube, Platonic solids, golden ratio and Fibonacci sequence, spirals, mandalas, labyrinths and yantras, alongside entries on the cultures, monuments, thinkers and systems where they appear, such as Pythagoras, Plato, Egyptian and Gothic architecture, the I Ching and Kabbalah. Each entry explains historical background and symbolic meaning and often suggests ways of using the form in meditation or creative work. It is a handy modern reference for identifying and interpreting geometric symbols across traditions.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
